verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs confirm multi-location companies can have different pay schedules ('might want everyone paid at the same time, or prefer different pay schedules based on location or job type') and that payrolls are auto-generated per company's pay schedule and pay periods, supporting the general capability. However, the pack never explicitly enumerates the specific frequency types (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly) or shows an API/UI flow for configuring multiple schedules per team. missing for 10: explicit list of supported pay frequencies, documented API/UI steps for creating/assigning schedules to specific teams.
